Do you enjoy turning complex data into clear choices that help VELUX use resources wisely? As S&OP Specialist, you will work across functions to develop scenarios and recommendations that support senior management in making key planning decisions.

Meet your future team

You will join Global Planning – S&OP & Planning Excellence, a team that collaborates cross-functionally with Marketing, Regional Management, Supply and Finance to support connected planning processes across VELUX. The team consists of six colleagues based in Skjern and Kolding.

The S&OP Specialist is a new role in the team, introduced to ensure better alignment across functions in the planning processes.

What We Offer

As S&OP Specialist, you will support the Global S&OP process by consolidating market input, preparing scenarios and creating decision material and recommendations for senior management. You will bring structure to S&OP preparation and ensure that agreed decisions are translated into clear planning requirements.

As part of your onboarding, you will be introduced and trained in the current Demand Planning processes and tools to build your understanding of the VELUX supply chain and planning processes.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Ensure that worst/best case sales scenarios is agreed and aligned with the regional management in key markets and understand their assumptions, risk and opportunities.

• Support the global Demand Planning Network in coordinating market input, sales uncertainties, campaigns, allocation requirements and scenarios.

• Plan and facilitate Pre-S&OP meetings and prepare topics that require decisions.

• Develop and evaluate scenarios with Sales, Supply, Purchasing, and Finance, including implications for service, inventory, capacity, production, costs and financial performance.

• Prepare clear decision material for Global S&OP meetings, outlining alternatives, business trade-offs, risks and required decisions.

• Document decisions and follow up on actions, deadlines and outcomes, while translating agreed decisions into input for Master Planning.

This role can be based in Skjern, Kolding, Østbirk or Hørsholm and you can expect minimal traveling in Denmark and abroad.

What You Will Bring Into The Organization

You bring experience from a planning-related role and understand how decisions on demand, supply, inventory and financial priorities connect across the value chain and have translated that understanding into measurable business outcomes.

You combine curiosity and structure with a commercial mindset and business acumen; you can challenge assumptions constructively and connect planning decisions to customer needs, operational trade-offs and financial performance.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring experience from Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, Supply Planning, Master Planning, Sales Forecasting or Supply Chain Analysis in fast-moving consumer goods.

• Have extensive understanding of S&OP and end-to-end supply chain planning, including how planning decisions affect service, capacity, inventory and production.

• Have advanced Excel skills, experience using Power BI for analysis and reporting, and familiarity with SAP BW/BWP data structures and data extraction.

• Have the financial understanding needed to assess business cases and quantify the implications of scenarios for costs, inventory, revenue and overall business performance.

• Can establish constructive working relationships with stakeholders across functions and levels to ensure that decisions, assumptions, responsibilities and actions are transparent and followed through.

• Can translate data-based scenarios into simple, clear visualisations that enable decision makers to compare options, understand key trade-offs and make informed decisions.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, "courage" and "mutual respect" define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At VELUX, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all - whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**Senior Engineer, Product Development – Product Simulation

****VELUX – Products & Innovation, LKR Innovation House, Østbirk

****Do you want to influence the next generation of roof window solutions through advanced product development with a special focus on simulation?

****Join VELUX and help shape innovative products that improve everyday living through daylight and fresh air.

****Meet your future team

**You will join the New Sloped Roof Windows Platforms area, where we develop scalable and high-performing roof window solutions for the future. Working closely with colleagues across Product Development, Engineering, and Category Management, we transform customer, market, business, and regulatory needs into innovative products and solutions.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting product development through simulation-driven insights that enable robust design decisions, product optimisation, and engineering excellence.

**What We Offer

**As Senior Engineer, Product Development – Product Simulation, you will contribute to developing future product platforms by applying your simulation expertise throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Your key responsibilities will include:

**

• Drive and execute simulation activities in close collaboration with internal and external partners, e.g. Center of Excellence for Simulation, Test departments, and across Product development initiatives.

• Translating product requirements into simulation and validation activities.

• Providing technical recommendations based on data-driven analyses and simulation results.

• Collaborating with design engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

• Supporting development and maintenance of simulation models to analyse product performance and behaviour.

• Supporting verification and validation activities throughout the development process.

• Be an active part of innovation and product optimisation initiatives across product platforms.

**What You Will Bring

**You are a curious and analytical engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and collaborating across disciplines. You take a structured approach to your work and communicate technical findings in a clear and constructive way.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Simulation Engineering, or a related field.

• Proficiency in simulation tools like ANSYS or Abaqus and have experience with creating and validating complex FEA models for static loads

• Preferable have touched upon dynamic simulation and CFD

• Have experience applying simulation tools and methods within product development.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are comfortable working in a cross-functional and international environment.

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• Are motivated by continuous improvement and innovation.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group at www.velux.com.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be conducted continuously until the position is filled.

All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**At the VELUX Group, we create healthier indoor environments for people around the world by bringing daylight and fresh air into homes and buildings. We are an international, family-owned company with strong values, a long-term perspective, and a commitment to making a positive impact on society, our employees, and the planet.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected, supported, and able to contribute their best. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, identity, experiences, or perspectives. We believe diversity strengthens innovation and helps us create better solutions for our customers and colleagues worldwide.

Field Service Electronics Engineer

Join ChemoMetec and be a part of our next-generation technology

Are you passionate about where mechanics meets electronics, and do you want to work for a company that pushes boundaries in life science instrumentation? We’re looking for a Field Service Electronics Engineer to maintain and service our brand-new XcytoMatic instrument platform across Europe. The XcytoMatic instruments are advanced lab equipment for automated cell counting. You’ll be based in Denmark at our headquarters in Allerød and travel to customers throughout Europe, with occasional trips to the Asia-Pacific region. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role where you’ll combine your technical expertise with a proactive mindset to keep instrument uptime and customer satisfaction high.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform annual preventive maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs on XcytoMatic instruments at customer sites across Europe, primarily biotech and pharma labs.

• Support customers on site in the Asia-Pacific region when needed.

• Service electromechanical systems, including firmware updates and module and component replacement.

• Inspect instruments and setups to identify and reduce risks that could lead to downtime, and read and troubleshoot system-generated log files.

• Work closely with R&D, Product Management and the service organization at our headquarters to share field insights and contribute to continuous product improvement.

• Act as a ChemoMetec ambassador, providing a high level of customer service and technical professionalism.

• Document all interventions in our service system (CRM).

What We’re Looking For

We’re searching for someone who thrives on solving complex problems and enjoys travelling to meet customers in their own environments. To succeed in this role, you have:

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

• 2+ years of field service experience, ideally with electromechanical laboratory equipment or automation systems.

• Strong knowledge of sensors, actuators, firmware interaction and basic networking.

• A curious mind and a real passion for technology.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**

What We Offer**

At ChemoMetec, you’ll be part of a growing life science company driven by innovation and a strong sense of purpose. We offer:

• A key role in the launch of our new XcytoMatic product line, shaping the future of automated cell counting.

• Thorough training and onboarding at our headquarters in Allerød.

• A supportive and highly skilled team of engineers and scientists.

• Opportunities to grow professionally in an international company with a strong focus on quality and technology.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

**

Practical information**

When you’re not travelling, you’ll be based at our headquarters in Allerød, Denmark, and will report to Tobias Schaldemose, Head of Operations US. The starting date is as soon as possible.

Please submit your CV and a short cover letter via our website. We’ll review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to reach out to tsc@chemometec.com.

Work location:

Gydevang 43

3450 Allerød

Danmark

13. January 2027

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

**Working at Ørsted

**In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

About the role

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a solid understanding of IT integrations and a talent for creating structure, progress and strong working relationships?

Scan Global Logistics is looking for a hands-on Technical Project Manager to support a major global transformation programme involving the implementation of new systems, global processes and data migration.

The programme implements a new Transportation Management System (TMFF), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, and a Vendor Invoice Management solution (Basware and AP Essentials.

As Technical Project Manager, you will play a key role in driving and coordinating integration projects across teams, integration specialists and business stakeholders.

Your primary responsibility will be to create structure, draft plans, ensure progress and make sure that tasks, responsibilities, dependencies and deadlines are clearly defined and followed up.

You will act as the link between diverse teams and the business, helping translate technical challenges into clear business requirements – and vice versa.

This is not a developer role. However, you should have a good technical understanding of integrations, data flows and system dependencies, enabling you to engage confidently in technical discussions and challenge proposed solutions when needed.

You should also enjoy getting involved in the practical aspects of project management, including communication, documentation, process descriptions and mapping integration flows. It is a must that you know when to support and when to drive tasks, content, colleagues to ensure progress.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and coordinate integration projects across implementation and integration teams and vendor teams, i.e., integration to e-invoicing governmental portals

• Act as the link between technical teams, system owners, implementation teams and business stakeholders.

• Create structure, clear priorities, realistic timelines and well-defined project plans.

• Ensure proper task management and follow-up in Jira.

• Make sure tasks are clearly described, assigned to the right people and followed through to completion. You support the integration team with describing their tasks, flow descriptions, etc.

• Coordinate resources, dependencies and delivery schedules across teams.

• Support the documentation of integration flows, system dependencies and processes.

• Translate technical issues into business requirements and ensure alignment between business and IT.

• Follow up on progress, identify bottlenecks and help resolve issues before they impact delivery.

• Coordinate testing, deployment and operational handover where relevant.

Your background

We are looking for someone with solid experience in technical project management and, in particular, system integration projects.

A background as a developer or experience working closely with developers and integration specialists would be a strong advantage. We are particularly interested in candidates who have moved from a technical development role into technical project management and can combine their technical understanding with strong project management skills.

Ideally, you have:

• Experience managing IT integration projects.

• A good understanding of APIs, CSV, data flows and integration patterns.

• An understanding of system dependencies and how different applications interact.

• Experience coordinating technical teams, developers or integration specialists.

• Experience with project planning, resource coordination, and delivery follow-up.

• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.

• The ability to create clear documentation, process descriptions and integration flow diagrams.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ERP or TMS solutions is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from logistics and transportation is also an advantage, but we are equally interested in candidates from finance, operations or other industries who have moved into IT and integration projects.

Who are you?

Your personality will be just as important as your technical and project management experience.

You are someone who can create momentum and gain the respect of others without relying on formal management authority.

You are structured, detail-oriented and persistent when it comes to following up and ensuring that things get done.

At the same time, you are approachable and understand the importance of building good relationships.

You are comfortable working with different personalities, handling disagreements and challenging existing ways of working in a constructive manner.

You know when to push and when to listen. You can stand your ground without being overly dominant, and you understand that successful project delivery depends on bringing people along.

You are pragmatic, have a good sense of humour and can navigate different situations with confidence and good judgement.

The team

You will report to the Programme Lead and work closely with integration specialists, system owners, workstream leads, implementation project managers and solution architects to mention just a few.

What we offer

• An important role in a major global transformation programme.

• An international working environment with colleagues across different countries.

• A role combining technical insight, project management and relationship building.

• The opportunity to make a visible difference to project delivery and collaboration.

Location: Hvidovre is preferred, but Viby is also an option for the right candidate.

**Travel:**Approximately once a month between locations.

Contact

The recruitment process is handled by EPICO Group. If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Mia Mûller, Senior Delivery Manager, Email: mbm@epico.dk, Prone: +45 2866 3943.

Why Scan Global Logistics?

At Scan Global Logistics, you will join a global growth company with an entrepreneurial spirit and a fast-paced environment. You will play a central role in a strategic transformation with high visibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Scan Global Logistics is a leading Danish logistics and transportation company headquartered in Hvidovre, Denmark. We provide global solutions within sea, air and road freight as well as supply chain management, helping businesses move their goods safely and efficiently around the world.

Did We Get Your Attention?

Icing on the Cake

This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and use them with respect. About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030.

Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**Want to own outcomes, not just output?

**At PriceShape, we’re looking for a Product Manager who cares less about whether something shipped and more about whether it worked.

We’re strengthening our product organisation, and you’ll join at a stage where you can influence not only what we build, but how we build it. Together with our Head of Product, designers and engineers, you’ll help create solutions that make a measurable difference for our customers and our business.

**About The Role

**As our Product Manager, your job is to make sure what we build reaches customers, gets used, and moves a number we care about.

You’ll work as part of a Product Trio with a designer and a tech lead, as peers throughout discovery and delivery. You bring the view of the customer and the business; they bring design and technical expertise. Together, you decide what to build.

We believe great product management is about understanding why something matters, making decisions based on evidence and learning from what works – and what doesn’t. Shipping a feature is not the finish line. The outcome moving is.

**What You’ll Be Doing

****Understand our customers and market

**

• Make direct customer contact a weekly habit, not an intention.

• Identify customer challenges, unmet needs and where our product falls short today.

• Know our competitive landscape well enough to say where we’re better, where we’re worse and what has quietly become table stakes.

• Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to turn customer feedback into well-understood problems, not a list of requests.

**Drive measurable outcomes

**

• Agree your team’s outcomes each quarter with the Head of Product, and define how success is measured.

• Decide which opportunities your team pursues, based on customer value, business impact and evidence.

• Test the riskiest assumptions first, and test them cheaply.

• Work directly with product data to understand whether an outcome actually moved.

**Build great products together

**

• Bring engineers and designers into the problem early, where they add the most value.

• Give the team the context it needs to make good decisions without you in the room: the strategy, the customer, the constraints and why it matters now.

• Resolve disagreements by testing assumptions, not by rank.

**Connect Product with the Business

**

• Build strong relationships across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Data & AI.

**What This Role Is Not

**

• Not a project manager. Project managers answer for when. This role answers for why, and for whether it worked.

• Not an order taker. Requests from stakeholders and customers are input, not instructions.

Over time, this role will move from reviewing individual pieces of work towards encoding judgment: personas, product principles and experiment frameworks that help the team make good decisions without needing to be gated. You’ll help shape what that looks like here.

**You enjoy getting close to customers, asking questions and challenging assumptions. You’re comfortable making decisions based on evidence, and equally comfortable deferring when someone else holds the relevant expertise.

You don’t need to have all the answers. What matters is your ability to ask the right questions, bring people together and turn insight into results.

**

• Hands-on experience with product discovery, customer interviews and assumption testing.

• A track record of working towards measurable outcomes rather than simply delivering features.

• Confidence working directly with product data.

• Experience working as a peer with engineering and design.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to give straight answers about what is and isn’t coming.

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have

**

• Experience within pricing, e-commerce, retail or brands.

• Experience with data-heavy products, where the product is the data itself.

• Familiarity with SQL or product analytics tools.

• Experience with or a genuine interest in how AI is changing product work.

You don’t need to tick every box. If you recognise yourself in the role, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**

• Real ownership: Accountability for meaningful outcomes, with the mandate to say no and to stop things.

• A chance to shape something: Help establish how our product organisation works as it grows.

• Empowered collaboration: Work as a peer with designers and engineers, and closely with our commercial teams.

• Support and development: Regular coaching and feedback from our Head of Product.

• Room to experiment: An environment where curiosity, testing and learning are expected.

• An international workplace: Colleagues from 25+ nationalities across disciplines and markets.

• Flexibility and balance: Flexible working hours, social activities, pension, health insurance and modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm.

**About PriceShape

**PriceShape is an international SaaS company headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark. Our platform helps retailers and brands make smarter pricing decisions through competitor tracking, pricing intelligence and automation, enabling them to increase revenue and profitability.

With around 80 colleagues from over 25 nationalities, we serve customers in more than 25 countries. We’re ambitious about where we’re going, and we’re continuously developing our products, our organisation and the way we work.

**Ready to apply?

**If you want to build products that solve real customer problems – and care about whether they actually did – we’d love to hear from you.

Apply by submitting your CV. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Per Mellqvist at pm@priceshape.com.

Director, Platform Engineering – Accelerate the SaaS transformation behind one of the world’s leading media platforms

Do you thrive at the intersection of organizational leadership, platform engineering, and SaaS transformation? Are you motivated by building teams and shared capabilities that enable other engineers to move faster, operate with greater autonomy, and deliver at scale?

At Stibo DX, we are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering to lead a strategically important engineering domain and drive our transition toward SaaS.

The role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will lead three global teams responsible for Cloud Platform, Print Platform, and Content Delivery. Together, these teams provide shared platform foundations, deployment capabilities, gateway infrastructure, APIs, and supporting services used across the Cue media enterprise platform.

Your primary mission is to accelerate the SaaS transformation. A central part of the role is to establish clear organizational boundaries between Platform Engineering, application teams, SRE, and Operations. Key responsibilities

You will lead and develop a distributed engineering organization while creating the structure, capabilities, and momentum required to scale Stibo DX’s SaaS transformation. You are not expected to be hands-on or to act as the chief platform architect. Interested?

As Construction Manager for bridge works, you will play a key role in the renewal of one of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets, working close to both the technical solutions and day-to-day construction activities.

In Great Belt Projects, you will contribute to projects including the West Bridge Bearing Refurbishment, where bearings on the West Bridge between Nyborg and Sprogø are being refurbished and replaced. The work is carried out while the Great Belt Fixed Link remains operational, requiring a strong focus on safety, quality and precise coordination.

The position

As Construction Manager, you will act as Sund & Bælt’s day-to-day coordinating client representative on site. You will monitor the contractor’s work and contribute to ensuring safe and controlled execution in accordance with the contract, approved methods and project requirements.

You will be part of the Great Belt Projects team and collaborate closely with project management, Contract Administration, Project Controls, Design & Engineering, HSE specialists, consultants, the contractor and Great Belt Operations.

Your primary base will be in Halsskov, with the option of working selected days from our office at Vester Søgade in Copenhagen. The role also requires your presence at relevant worksites and project locations.

You will represent the client’s interests with a strong focus on safety, quality and progress. You will be responsible for site supervision and carry out supervision activities yourself when required.  Your key responsibilities will include:

• Managing day-to-day client-side construction assurance through the consultants’ site supervision services, including monitoring the contractor’s execution of the works, resourcing, plant and equipment, site access, logistics and progress.

• Monitoring the contractor’s compliance with occupational health and safety, emergency preparedness, environmental and climate requirements, promoting an open and proactive safety culture, and coordinating fulfilment of the client’s occupational health and safety obligations.

• Have experience with occupational health and safety, emergency preparedness and the safe coordination of multiple parties.

• Are able to document site conditions accurately and systematically, providing a sound basis for progress monitoring, contract administration, risk management and decision-making.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

**Who We Are

We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a talented student assistant to strengthen our embedded systems work.

As Student Assistant in Embedded Systems, you will develop the firmware that brings our photonics lab setups to life. Working closely with our engineering team, you will build STM32-based systems for signal generation, acquisition, processing, and monitoring, turning hardware into working, measurable systems. This is a hands-on role with the opportunity, and expectation, to see your code run on real lab equipment from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain C firmware for STM32 microcontrollers, ensuring robust, well-structured code that supports our lab setups and experiments.

Interfaces & Device Control: Connect, configure, and control external devices over SPI and I2C, while ensuring reliable communication between the microcontroller and the surrounding hardware.

Signal Generation, Acquisition & Processing: Generate signals and waveforms, acquire and monitor analog signals, and process the acquired data on the MCU through filtering, averaging, and feature extraction.

Lab Work & Documentation: Bring up and debug hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers, while documenting code and results clearly and maintaining version control with Git.

What We Are Looking For

Education: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related discipline.

Embedded Experience: You bring good knowledge of C and microcontroller fundamentals along with practical experience with STM32 or comparable ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers.

Interfaces & Peripherals: You have hands-on experience with SPI, I2C, DMA, timers, ADC, and DAC, from configuring the peripheral to debugging it on the bench.

Electronics: You are able to read and understand electronic circuits, schematics, and datasheets. Electronics skills such as circuit design, soldering, and measurement, as well as real-world lab experience, are considered an advantage. Experience with PCB design (KiCad or Altium) and Python or MATLAB for data analysis is a plus.

Soft Skills: You are a structured and independent problem-solver who enjoys working at the boundary between hardware and software, communicates effectively with colleagues, and thrives in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required.

The Perks

We care about your growth and development. You will work on cutting-edge photonics and embedded technology alongside highly motivated colleagues, with access to a well-equipped lab. We offer competitive hourly pay, flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams, a positive culture with free snacks, and the opportunity to write your Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis with us.

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Our platform and APIs provide the building blocks for specialized intelligence that organizations own:

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

• 
Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

This is a full-time role reporting to the CTO. We provide equipment and relocation support.

We welcome different backgrounds and paths into machine learning. If the work fits your ambition and you bring substantial relevant experience, apply even if you do not match every item.

Send us something you built, a hard problem you solved, or a result you think deserves to be challenged. A link is enough. Help us shape the models, agents, and infrastructure developers build on next.

Additionally, we want to remind you that experience comes in many forms, and we're passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we're looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you consider applying!
